svg.title: Greek Theogony
svg.desc: A visual map of ancient Greek gods, collective divine races, immediate families and selected parent traditions.

text.tspan: A coloured region surrounds the children of one
parent. It is drawn in that parent's group colour.
Where two regions overlap, the figures inside
share both parents. Zeus, for example, sits
